issues: The episode is from Dynamics Corner, but the whole conversation is about AI in B2B marketing in general (answer engines, brand gravity, employee advocacy, AI-friendly websites, outsourcing). Business Central is never mentioned.
None of the 17 listed features is a Business Central feature. They are marketing ideas, so they would mislead on a BC knowledge page.
The systems tags (copilot, sales, crm) are not supported. Copilot only comes up in a list of chat models people can pick, and sales and CRM are only talked about in general terms.
The key point about an 85% finalist list misstates the transcript. It says buyers had formed a finalist list about 85% of the time, not that the list was 85% accurate.
Quotes at t=291.3 and t=2679.8 are cut off with an ellipsis. Quotes at t=814.7 and t=2443 appear twice as near-copies.
All 17 features are marked unclear and have no evidence, which fits the lack of product content.
